name: Subhakrit Rajbhandari
intro: Cybersecurity enthusiast with a strong passion for securing digital systems and ethical hacking, sparked from an early age. Driven by curiosity and a focus on understanding systems and applications to make them stronger and more resilient. Committed to continuous learning and enhancing digital ecosystems in the ever evolving field of cybersecurity. Helping organizations validate their security posture through rigorous manual assessments of web applications, APIs, mobile apps, and thick clients, and delivering clear, actionable remediation aligned with industry best practices.
